title: Civil-rights leadership comparison
goal: Students can distinguish shared leadership traits from each figure's distinct approaches.

rubric.must: Two named central figures are visible on opposite sides.
Shared traits appear in central bubbles connected to both figures.
Unique traits appear only on their respective outer sides.
